concepts.plainMeaning: Market rule counting days between coupons to calculate exact accrued interest.
concepts.roleHere: Sets accrued interest across Treasury, corporate, and money-market securities.
concepts.analogy: Prorating monthly apartment rent cleanly by the exact calendar days you stayed.

concepts.plainMeaning: Total cash price actually paid for a bond, adding accrued interest to quoted clean price.
concepts.roleHere: Separates quoted screen price from true settlement cash.
concepts.analogy: Seeing a menu price plus mandatory service charge when paying your restaurant bill.

concepts.plainMeaning: The quoted bond price displayed without accrued coupon interest.
concepts.roleHere: Base price adjusted by Conversion Factor inside Treasury futures.
concepts.analogy: The sticker tag before adding prorated coupon interest owed to the seller.

concepts.plainMeaning: Standardizing multiplier valuing a bond as if its yield were 6.0% semi-annual.
concepts.roleHere: Allows heterogeneous Treasury bonds to settle into one futures contract.
concepts.analogy: Currency exchange weights converting foreign coins into one uniform score.

concepts.plainMeaning: Actual cash settlement amount equals settlement times conversion factor plus accrued interest.
concepts.roleHere: Governs cash wired to the short seller upon physical bond delivery.
concepts.analogy: Scaling a standardized ticket by grade multiplier plus accrued daily storage.

concepts.plainMeaning: The specific eligible Treasury bond minimizing net purchase minus delivery proceeds.
concepts.roleHere: Determines which real bond tracks CBOT Treasury bond futures.
concepts.analogy: A contractor choosing the lowest-cost approved material that satisfies building specs.

concepts.plainMeaning: Short delivery option capturing late-day bond drops between 2:00 PM settlement and 8:00 PM cutoff.
concepts.roleHere: Timing edge built into CBOT settlement rules.
concepts.analogy: Locking an afternoon auction price while keeping until evening to choose whether to ship.

concepts.plainMeaning: Major derivatives exchange organizing Treasury bond futures settlement and delivery rules.
concepts.roleHere: Exchange governing the 15-year delivery basket and 2:00 PM / 8:00 PM clock.
concepts.analogy: The central clearinghouse stadium setting delivery rules for Treasury futures.

concepts.plainMeaning: Coupon interest earned since the last payment date and owed to the bond seller.
concepts.roleHere: Added to clean price to get dirty cash settlement and invoice totals.
concepts.analogy: Prorated daily rent earned between billing dates.
